answer.text: Gross margin % on Safety Equipment in AU-EAST was stable at about 46% from Q1 2025 to Q1 2026 (45.9%, 46.3%, 46.0%, 46.0%, 46.3%). It then fell sharply to 38.1% in Q2 2026 and stayed there: 38.1% in Q3 and 38.0% in Q4 to date. That is a drop of about 8 points. I haven't looked into the cause.

sql.sql:
select date_trunc('quarter', s.order_date)::date as period, round(100 * sum(s.margin_nzd) / nullif(sum(s.net_amount_nzd), 0), 2) as gross_margin_pct
from marts.fct_sales as s
inner join marts.dim_product as p on p.product_key = s.product_key
where s.order_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s and p.category = any(%(filter_0)s) and s.region = any(%(filter_1)s)
group by 1
order by 1
limit %(row_limit)s
